systems_found: North Dakota University System (NDUS: 11 institutions incl. UND, NDSU, and the 2-year colleges BSC, LRSC, WSC, NDSCS, DCB)

sources.institution: All state agencies and all NDUS institutions
sources.system: State of North Dakota OMB Financial Transparency portal
sources.coverage_years: last ten fiscal years (per help page), monthly detail
sources.institutions_covered: All NDUS campuses (universities and 2-year colleges) plus state agencies; excludes Bank of ND, Mill & Elevator, Roughrider Industries, Housing & Finance
sources.employees: all paid through PeopleSoft payroll (full-time, temporary, overtime split by expense type); some names redacted for safety
sources.format: IBM Cognos Analytics dashboard (JavaScript BI app)
fields: employee_name (uncertain: help page describes the table as 'by agency and position')
sources.update_frequency: monthly (mid-month; June data at end of July)
sources.terms: not stated on dashboard; OMB site has a Disclaimer page
sources.blocker: Data only reachable through an interactive Cognos dashboard (filters limited to first 100 options); no published bulk payroll file or documented API.
sources.notes: Official and covers every public college in ND, including 2-year colleges, with total pay by type, which is good content. Cognos loaded anonymously (HTTP 200) but renders client-side; Cognos sometimes allows per-widget CSV export or a REST call underneath, which could be explored with a browser to lift it to B. Could not confirm whether employee names are shown.

sources.system: State of North Dakota OMB Mass Download (checkbook)
sources.employees: n/a (vendor payments; payroll inclusion not confirmed)
sources.notes: Bulk checkbook (expenditure) files, described as 'detailed checkbook data'; almost certainly vendor payments, not person-level payroll. Not downloaded (large). Recorded in case payroll lines turn out to be included; if they are, this would be an A.

sources.institutions_covered: NDSU, UND, NDUS Core Technology Services, others
sources.blocker: Cloudflare blocks automated requests (HTTP 403 'Sorry, you have been blocked'); third-party, HTML only.
sources.notes: Its existence suggests the state data does include names; likely derived from the OMB portal or a records request.

private_extra: None. ND has very few private colleges (University of Mary, University of Jamestown); none found publishing pay beyond IRS 990.
gaps: No clean bulk download of person-level higher-ed payroll. The official Cognos dashboard covers all NDUS institutions, including community colleges, but is interactive only and may not show names. Tribal colleges are not state institutions and are not covered.
notes: Rated the OMB Cognos dashboard C, not B, because it is a JS BI tool rather than scrapable HTML. Did not download the 22-39MB checkbook XLSX files to check for payroll rows, per the no-large-downloads rule. OpenPayrolls was blocked by Cloudflare; not bypassed.
